text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! I made it all the way to the
end of my
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you very much!
choice_data_list: You did great out there, Spe!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't really hit me yet.
I'm still in a bit
of a
daze.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Anyhow! This means our journey towards
the
Twinkle Series has really begun!

Special Week manages to get through
her debut
and returns to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've achieved our first goal
and made
a successful debut, we should
be deciding on our
next race, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And now that we have to decide, I want
you to
know there's a race that I've
always wanted to run
in!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup! A once-in-a-lifetime race that only
classic year racers can take part in—one
that determines
the best of the
generation!
choice_data_list: Was there a race you wanted to enter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna race in the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna become the best in Japan, so I
need to
grab that Derby Umamusume
title!

She's right. This race is basically a
requirement for
any Umamusume
aspiring to be number one.

What's more, the news of Spe becoming
a Derby
Umamusume would reach all the
way to her
mother in Hokkaido for sure!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You got it, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Alright, our next goal is the Japa...
Alright, our next goal is the Japa...

text_block_list.text:
Our goal is set, but Special Week
doesn't have
enough experience to
challenge the Derby yet.

It would be wiser to run in a fairly
popular race
first. Which is why...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a G3?! A graded race... Th-that's a
lotta
pressure...
choice_data_list: First up, we're running in the Kis...
First, let's run in the Kisaragi Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I do need
experience—especially if we're
aiming
for the Derby!
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll be a good experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I'll run in the Kisaragi Sho
to learn
what a real race feels like!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time to get started on my
path to the
Derby!
